name: World-readable bucket holding customer exports (the cloud-surface remediation)

before.title: S3 bucket acme-customer-exports is readable by anyone
before.description: The bucket policy grants s3:GetObject to the * principal. The bucket holds nightly customer exports, so every object is world-readable.

before.title: Root account has no MFA
before.description: The account root user can authenticate with a password alone.

before.title: Bucket missing an owner tag
before.description: A build-cache bucket has no owner tag. A tagging-hygiene gap, not a security exposure.

after.title: Bucket missing an owner tag
after.description: Still present after remediation — it was never a security exposure.
